name: luna-vscode-ext
description: Reverse-engineered replica of the Claude Code VS Code extension's MCP server and host integration. Spawns the real bundled `claude` binary and exposes an MCP server to it over stdio.

lunaCode.claudeBinaryPath.description: Absolute path to the bundled `claude` native binary (from the official VSIX resources/native-binary/claude).

lunaCode.workspaceCwd.description: Working directory passed to claude. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

lunaCode.enableExtensionMcp.description: Register the in-process `claude-vscode-extension` MCP server (name + version mirror the official extension) so Claude can call IDE/back-end tools.

lunaCode.enableIdeMcp.description: Start the HTTP/WS `Claude Code {Editor} MCP` server carrying the 12 IDE-interaction tools (openFile/getDiagnostics/executeCode/...). Writes a lock file under ~/.claude/ide/<port>.lock so the bundled claude binary can discover it.

lunaCode.model.description: Model id passed to claude. Defaults to claude's own default.
